description: A map of a delivery: origin, destination, route and a courier marker that glides between position updates. Tiles come from `tileUrlTemplate` as in `MapView`.

props.name: semanticLabel
props.description: What the map shows, spoken before its markers.

props.name: courier
props.description: The courier's position; bindable, the marker animates to each new value.

props.name: etaLabel
props.description: The arrival estimate, shown over the map and spoken.

props.name: tileUrlTemplate
props.description: The tile URL with `{z}`, `{x}` and `{y}`; HTTPS on a declared domain.

props.name: attribution
props.description: The tile provider's attribution, always shown; required when `tileUrlTemplate` is set.

props.name: originLabel
props.description: The origin marker's name for screen readers; the marker is silent without it.

props.name: destinationLabel
props.description: The destination marker's name for screen readers; the marker is silent without it.

props.name: courierLabel
props.description: The courier marker's name for screen readers; the marker is silent without it.
